hypothesis: If station-verdict.go (L299) uses --green, the Go/No-Go poll conflates 'station review cleared' with governance-ADMITTED (🟢). Since LEDGER=HOLD and MAYOR=PENDING when GO fires for HER/HAL, the system cannot be admitted — green is wrong. --amber cannot substitute because L301 already assigns it to PENDING within the same panel. --blue (OBSERVED) is the only available SA palette slot for 'station has checked and cleared' without adding a new CSS variable.
summary: The Go/No-Go panel (L1056-1064) is a pre-admission review gate — 'All stations must be GO before SHIP is authorized' (L1059). HER=GO (L1060, 'Proposal ready') and HAL=GO (L1061, 'Admissibility checked') represent station-level review clearances, not ledger admissions. Yet both render via .station-verdict.go{color:var(--green)} (L299), the same color SA doctrine reserves exclusively for governance-ADMITTED. LEDGER shows HOLD (receipt missing) and MAYOR is PENDING — the full system is not admitted — but individual GO stations appear in ADMITTED-level green. --amber (🟠 REVIEW) cannot substitute cleanly: L301 already assigns --amber to .station-verdict.pend (PENDING state), so both PENDING and GO-cleared would share the same color within the same panel. --blue (OBSERVED: #5b8af0) is unused in the gonogo panel and available. SA semantic fit: OBSERVED = 'seen and recorded' ≈ 'station has inspected and recorded its clearance' — closest available slot without introducing a new palette variable.

proposed_tweak: Change .station-verdict.go L299: color:var(--green) → color:var(--blue). Single-line change; reverses trivially. 'Station review cleared' maps to 🔵 OBSERVED (--blue:#5b8af0) — station has observed and cleared its gate; not yet ledger-admitted. HOLD remains --red (breach). PENDING remains --amber (review pending). GO becomes --blue (observed+cleared at station level).
metric: grep -n 'station-verdict' index.html shows .station-verdict.go uses var(--blue). In browser: HER and HAL GO rows render blue; HOLD rows remain red; PENDING row remains amber. --green disappears from gonogo panel entirely. Semantic check: no other gonogo panel element uses --blue — intra-panel collision-free.
rule: KEEP if --blue is free within the gonogo panel (confirmed: only HOLD=red, PENDING=amber exist there; --blue unassigned). REJECT if operator determines station GO warrants a stronger positive signal requiring a new --teal palette entry distinct from OBSERVED.
